facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-hit.create_GuiAppRenderer_subclass: create a subclass of GuiAppRenderer implementing post_sim_update, render_update, and unproject methods
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-hit.build_InputHandlerApplication_for_key_ev: build an InputHandlerApplication subclass to handle key press and release events with GuiInput
